description: Purchase a single seller-signal lead from the Scout MCP marketplace. Deducts the per-lead price from your pre-paid credit balance and returns the full owner contact + property details. Idempotent — calling with a lead_id you've already purchased returns the same data without a second charge. Requires 'buy_leads' scope and a positive balance (top up at scout.realestate/partners/mcp/credits).
name: scout.purchase_lead
